text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text:
By the power of Santa Claus's sack,
the people of Landosol have one by one been turned into reindeer.
{0} and his entourage are rushing to put a stop to it.
text_block_list.orig_text:
サンタクロースの袋の力によって、
次々とトナカイへと変えられてゆくランドソルの人々。
それを止めるため、{0}たちは走る。

text_block_list.name: Boss Reindeer
text_block_list.text:
Brrrooooooooaaaar!
(I, the new Santa Claus,
will destroy this holiday once and for all!)
text_block_list.orig_text:
ブオオオオオオオオオオオオオオ──！
（新たなサンタクロースとなった俺が、
クリスマスをぶち壊してやろう──！）

text_block_list.name: Illya
text_block_list.text:
We've finally caught up!
...I recognize this place.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ようやく追いついたわい！
……と、
ここは見覚えがあるのう？

text_block_list.name: Nozomi
text_block_list.text: It's where we held our holiday concert!
text_block_list.orig_text: クリスマスライブの会場！？

text_block_list.name: Christina
text_block_list.text:
You have a discerning eye choosing this venue... ♪
Both singing and fighting are entertainment worthy of the stage.
Let us make the most of this opportunity!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ここを選ぶとはお目が高い……♪
戦いも歌も舞台上の娯楽。
存分に盛り上げよう！

text_block_list.name: Illya
text_block_list.text:
Hold your tongue, Christina!
This is not the time for solo ripostes!
text_block_list.orig_text:
これクリスティーナ！
単身で突っ込んでゆくでないわ！

text_block_list.name: Christina
text_block_list.text:
Hahah. ☆
In situations like this, it is best to concede to your elders!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ははっ☆
こういう時は年長者に譲るがいいよ！

text_block_list.name: Illya
text_block_list.text: [i]I[/i] am the elder in this situation!
text_block_list.orig_text: わらわのほうが年長者じゃというに！

text_block_list.name: Christina
text_block_list.text: Steel yourself! ☆
text_block_list.orig_text: そぉれっ☆

text_block_list.name: Boss Reindeer
text_block_list.text:
Broar!
(Rngh!)
text_block_list.orig_text:
ブオウッ！
（ぬぅんっ！）

text_block_list.name: Nozomi
text_block_list.text: It blocked the attack with its antler?!
text_block_list.orig_text: 角で受け止めた！？

text_block_list.name: Boss Reindeer
text_block_list.text:
Broooar!
(Weakling!)
text_block_list.orig_text:
ブオオオオンッ！
（羽虫がっ！）

text_block_list.name: Christina
text_block_list.text: We have a tough guy— Oh?
text_block_list.orig_text:
なんの、
これしき──
おや？

text_block_list.name: Illya
text_block_list.text:
You got knocked away?!
Did I not warn you?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
吹っ飛ばされおった！？
それ見たことか！

text_block_list.name: Christina
text_block_list.text: ...'Tis but a scratch!
text_block_list.orig_text: ……かすっただけだ！

text_block_list.name: Christina
text_block_list.text:
It should be impossible for the reindeer to block my attack or even graze me... Is the response of my Numbers Avalon being dulled? 
Could it be the snow?
text_block_list.orig_text:
本来、
受け止められるわけもかするわけもないんだが……
乱数聖域の反応が鈍い？　
雪のせいか？

text_block_list.name: Christina
text_block_list.text:
Those muscles of yours are far more than meet the eye.
You managed to land a solid blow the instant I hesitated... ♪
text_block_list.orig_text:
あの筋骨隆々、
見た目以上の膂力じゃあないか。
刹那の惑いを的確に打ちぬかれてしまったぞ……♪

text_block_list.name: Nozomi
text_block_list.text:
Are you okay, Producer?!
You're laughing, but that was a bad hit...
text_block_list.orig_text:
大丈夫ですか、
プロデューサー！？
笑っていますけど、
当たり所が悪かったんじゃ……？

text_block_list.name: Christina
text_block_list.text:
Ahahahah! ☆ I cannot help but laugh!
To face off against such a worthy foe on this special night
is the greatest gift a girl could ever ask for!
text_block_list.orig_text:
あっはは☆　
これが綻ばずにいられるか！
聖夜に相応しい強敵、
ワタシへの何よりのプレゼントだよ！

text_block_list.name: Illya
text_block_list.text:
My apologies, but I must sequester your present, for now it is my turn!
The only way to attack such a large adversary is from a distance!
text_block_list.orig_text:
プレゼントを横取りして悪いが、
次はわらわの番じゃ！
でかい図体には
遠距離から攻めるに限るわっ！

text_block_list.name: Boss Reindeer
text_block_list.text:
Broar!
(Futile!)
text_block_list.orig_text:
ブオウン！
（効かぬ！）

text_block_list.name: Illya
text_block_list.text: My magic...
text_block_list.orig_text: わらわの魔法を……

text_block_list.name: Nozomi
text_block_list.text: It was absorbed by the sack...
text_block_list.orig_text:
袋で、
吸収しちゃいましたね……

text_block_list.name: Illya
text_block_list.text: So it's no holds barred, I see!
text_block_list.orig_text: 何でもありにもほどがあるじゃろーーーーーっ！？

text_block_list.name: Boss Reindeer
text_block_list.text:
Broooooar!
(Now you're on my naughty list!)
text_block_list.orig_text:
ブォォォォォォンッ！
（プレゼントを受け取るがいいっ！）

text_block_list.name: Illya
text_block_list.text:
I-it's swinging its sack all over the place...!
If I had been hit, it would have finished me off!
Much obliged... I was saved thanks to you.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ふ、
袋を振り回してきおった……！
あんなもんで殴られたら
ひとたまりもないではないか！
すまぬの……
お主のおかげで助かったぞ。

text_block_list.name: Nozomi
text_block_list.text:
To think that both your attacks would have no effect...
Who would've thought those reindeer were that strong...?
text_block_list.orig_text:
プロデューサーとイリヤさんの攻撃が通じないなんて……
トナカイさん、こんなに強かったんだね……

text_block_list.name: Christina
text_block_list.text: Ha. It is but a lowly reindeer.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ふん。
だが所詮はトナカイ風情。

text_block_list.name: Illya
text_block_list.text:
That is correct.
It is no match for the legendary vampire.
text_block_list.orig_text:
そうじゃそうじゃ。
伝説の吸血鬼たるわらわの敵ではないわ。

text_block_list.name: Nozomi
text_block_list.text: If we work together, I'm sure we can do something!
text_block_list.orig_text:
みんなで協力すれば、
きっと何とかできますよね！

text_block_list.name: Boss Reindeer
text_block_list.text: Brrrrrrrooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaarrrrrrrr!
text_block_list.orig_text: ──ブオオオオオオオオオオオオオオオオオオオオオオオオオオオオオオオオオオオオオオオオオオオオオオオオオオオオオオオオオオオオオオオオオオオオオオオオオオオオオオオオオオオオオオオオオオオオオオオ！

text_block_list.name: Nozomi
text_block_list.text: Huh? Wh-what?! What's up with it all of a sudden?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
えっ、
な、
何！？　
急にどうしたの！？

text_block_list.name: Illya
text_block_list.text: That roar... I have a bad feeling about it.
text_block_list.orig_text:
今の咆哮……
何やら
嫌な予感がするのう。

text_block_list.name: Christina
text_block_list.text:
Hmph. Does that reindeer have more tricks hiding in its sack?
What's next?
text_block_list.orig_text:
ふむ。
他にも芸を仕込んでいるのか？
何が出るやら──

text_block_list.name: Reindeer
text_block_list.text: ...Brouh.
text_block_list.orig_text: ……ブオ。

text_block_list.name: Nozomi
text_block_list.text: Huh? Look... it's all the people from town who were turned into reindeer!
text_block_list.orig_text:
え？　
これは……
トナカイに変えられた町の人たち！？

text_block_list.name: Christina
text_block_list.text: Hmmmm. They've all gathered in this venue.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ふむ。
この広場に集まってきているな。

text_block_list.name: Illya
text_block_list.text:
My, is it getting lively...
Even if it is nothing but reindeer.
choice_data_list: There's a legendary vampire here too.
There's a famous idol here too.
text_block_list.orig_text:
賑やかになってきおったのう……
ほとんどトナカイしかおらぬが。

text_block_list.name: Illya
text_block_list.text:
Insolence! How dare you bundle me together with mere reindeer!
What do you think I am?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ええい
トナカイとひとくくりにするでないわ！
わらわを何じゃと思うとる！

text_block_list.name: Christina
text_block_list.text:
Hahah, how interesting.
A legendary vampire would make quite the spectacle. ♪
text_block_list.orig_text:
ははっ、
面白いじゃないか。
伝説の吸血鬼はいい見せ物になりそうだ♪

text_block_list.name: Nozomi
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Are you expecting me to do something?
Ummm... Hi everyone, thanks for waiting!
text_block_list.orig_text:
えっ、
もしかして私何か期待されてる？
えっと、
みんな～、
お待たせ～！

text_block_list.name: Christina
text_block_list.text:
Idol of Carmina,
there is no need to treat a reindeer as your rival...
text_block_list.orig_text:
【カルミナ】のアイドルが
トナカイに張り合おうとしないでくれ……

text_block_list.name: Illya
text_block_list.text: But that roar... Could it be trying to—
text_block_list.orig_text:
しかし
さっきの咆哮、
まさか──

text_block_list.name: Reindeer
text_block_list.text: Broough!
text_block_list.orig_text: ブオオオッ！

text_block_list.name: Illya
text_block_list.text: As I thought, it's controlling all the reindeer!
text_block_list.orig_text:
やはり、
トナカイを操っておるようじゃ！

text_block_list.name: Christina
text_block_list.text:
As can only be expected from an elite reindeer.
What amazing leadership!
text_block_list.orig_text:
さすがはエリートトナカイというだけのことはある、
大したリーダーシップだ！

text_block_list.name: Nozomi
text_block_list.text:
Producer, this isn't the time to be praising it!
The other reindeer are gathering in droves...!
At this rate, we'll be surrounded in no time!
text_block_list.orig_text:
褒めてる場合じゃないですよプロデューサー！
トナカイさんたち、どんどん集まってきてて……！
このままじゃ囲まれちゃいます！

text_block_list.name: Boss Reindeer
text_block_list.text:
Brouh!
(You're wide open!)
text_block_list.orig_text:
ブオオッ！
（隙ありぃっ！）

text_block_list.name: Nozomi
text_block_list.text: Eeek!
text_block_list.orig_text: きゃっ！？

text_block_list.name: Nozomi
text_block_list.text:
{0}...!
Thanks for protecting me!
text_block_list.orig_text:
{0}くん……！
守ってくれてありがとうっ！

text_block_list.name: Reindeer
text_block_list.text: Brooough!
text_block_list.orig_text: ブオオオオオッ！

text_block_list.name: Christina
text_block_list.text:
Hngh... These reindeer are more of a nuisance than I expected.
But they are former people, so we cannot simply cut them down.
Unless...? Shall we just proceed to slice them up?
text_block_list.orig_text:
むぅ、
周りのトナカイが存外邪魔だな。
だがこいつらは元人間、
斬って捨てるわけにも……
いや、
もういっそ斬ってしまおうか？

text_block_list.name: Illya
text_block_list.text:
Stay your hand!
The day will come when they will be under my control, so I cannot permit you to do them harm!
text_block_list.orig_text:
やめんか！
いずれは
我が支配下におかれる者たちじゃ、
傷つけることは許さん！

text_block_list.name: Nozomi
text_block_list.text:
Whether you'll rule them or not, we mustn't hurt them!
Because I'm sure the townspeople, and even the elite reindeer,
weren't bad to begin with!
text_block_list.orig_text:
支配とかはともかく、
傷つけるのはダメですよ！
町の人たちはもちろん、
あのエリートトナカイさんたちだって、
元々はきっと悪い子じゃないんですから……！

text_block_list.name: Boss Reindeer
text_block_list.text:
Brouh, broooooar!
(We refuse to accept a holiday that exploits reindeer labor!)
text_block_list.orig_text:
ブォッ、
ブオオオオオオッ！
（トナカイをこき使うためのクリスマスなどいらぬ！）

text_block_list.name: Christina
text_block_list.text:
Tch...! Do you actually have a grasp of the situation?
We're not going to sit in a circle holding hands and singing Kumbaya.
What an utterly naive sentiment.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ちぃっ……！　
今の状況を理解していて、
全員手と手繋いで大団円、
なんて甘～い理想を語っているのか？

text_block_list.name: Nozomi
text_block_list.text: ...Yes we will!
text_block_list.orig_text: ……はい！

text_block_list.name: Nozomi
text_block_list.text: Because today is...
text_block_list.orig_text:
だって、
今日は……

text_block_list.name: Illya
text_block_list.text:
Ah, of course.
Because today is...
text_block_list.orig_text:
ああ、
そうじゃの。
何しろ今日は……

text_block_list.name: Christina
text_block_list.text:
...I see.
When you put it like that, I can do naught but stand down.
text_block_list.orig_text:
……なるほど。
そう言われてしまっては、仕方がない。

text_block_list.name: Christina
text_block_list.text:
Therefore,
you must do something about these reindeer formerly known as people.
Reindeer Prime belongs to me and Illya Ornstein.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ならばオマエが、
この元人間のトナカイたちを何とかしてみせろ。
あのデカブツは
ワタシとイリヤ・オーンスタインで片付ける。

text_block_list.name: Nozomi
text_block_list.text:
Huh? I'm supposed to deal with the reindeer people...?!
What?! How...?
text_block_list.orig_text:
え？　
私が、
このトナカイさんたちを……！？
そんな、
どうやって……

text_block_list.name: Christina
text_block_list.text:
Enough of the bewilderment.
Tell me again what it is you are.
text_block_list.orig_text:
何を戸惑う。
──オマエは何者だ？

text_block_list.name: Nozomi
text_block_list.text:
Me...?
I am... an idol of Carmina!
text_block_list.orig_text:
私……？
私は……
【カルミナ】のアイドルです！

text_block_list.name: Christina
text_block_list.text:
Then as an idol,
do a splendid job as your producer demands!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ならばアイドルとして、
プロデューサーの要求に見事応えてみせろ！

text_block_list.name: Christina
text_block_list.text:
Be they Santa or be they reindeer,
mesmerize them with your voice, Nozomi!
text_block_list.orig_text:
サンタだろうがトナカイだろうが、
オマエの歌で魅了してみせろ──
ノゾミ！

text_block_list.name: Nozomi
text_block_list.text:
...Right!
You got it, Producer!
text_block_list.orig_text:
……はいっ！
分かりました、
プロデューサー！

text_block_list.name: Boss Reindeer
text_block_list.text:
Brrrooooooooaaar!
(This holiday that causes only reindeer suffering ends here!)
text_block_list.orig_text:
ブモオオオオオオオオオオ！
（トナカイが苦しむだけのクリスマスなんてなくなってしまえばいい！）

text_block_list.name: Illya
text_block_list.text: On your guard, Christina!
text_block_list.orig_text:
来るぞ！　
クリスティーナ！
